svg.text: Music has a remarkable ability to transport us to another time and place. A familiar song can bring back
vivid memories or stir emotions we haven't felt in years. This week, music psychologist Elizabeth
Margulis explores how our brains transform sounds into deeply personal experiences, and why the meaning
of music always depends on the listener. Then, psychologist Daisy Fancourt returns to the show to answer
listener questions about the healing benefits of the arts.
What makes a painting a masterpiece? Why do you remember some paintings and forget others? If an AI that
knows nothing about art can pick masterpieces by using only pixels, what does that tell us? We explore
these questions on the Hidden Brain Youtube channel — you can watch the video here.

use of personal data for advertising.
